currentRoundInspection.scope: Useful pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only;no bespoke surveys or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observed: Inspected elevated axial front: yellow plaster and pale trim, bowed multi-bay west facade with curved crown and sculptural silhouettes, black metal central dome with gold lantern/cross, long side roofs and cross-plan projections. Separate low courtyard wings surround the west court and are excluded.

Inspected elevated side: tall pale/yellow central drum with chamfered corners and dark bowed dome, gold lantern, lower dark nave and transverse roofs, selected pilasters and rounded upper windows, separate wings/gate and landscape.

Inspected close front: tall central round arch window over single recessed door, doubled pale pilasters, projecting cornices following the bowed bays, curved gable with central crest field and equestrian silhouette, two selected standing figures, split entry stairs/balustrades and central arched grotto. Exact sculpture, carved coats of arms and interiors omitted.
